flavor: Black, oily residue coats the floor, reflecting nothing. Amidst the gloom, a pile of silvered bones and tarnished heirlooms rests atop a pedestal of obsidian, pulsing with a faint, rhythmic violet light.
name: The Reliquary of Hollowed Veins
reason: The party has navigated the necrotic currents of the dungeon to find a cache of sanctified remains and stolen finery.
